personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines, standard methods, and well-tested procedures, and may resist unfamiliar ideas until they have been carefully vetted. They are highly organized and meticulous, often planning ahead in detail, checking for errors, and maintaining strict personal standards. In moral dilemmas, they usually analyze the situation carefully but may become anxious, suspicious of others’ intentions, and inclined to protect their own interests if they feel uncertain or pressured. In group discussions, they speak readily and energetically, but their comments can be forceful, competitive, and critical, with a tendency to question assumptions and revisit concerns repeatedly when stressed.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
